editor_note: Entry 102 renders "Custom Functions" as "Funzioni personalizzate". That is the standard, natural Italian rendering, and it keeps the {#custom-functions} anchor intact.

The meaning is faithful throughout. The caveats about TTL, ordering, calibration jobs and the Open Plan restriction all survive, and "tu" is used consistently. A few calques are worth fixing. In [9], "esegue l'esecuzione quantistica" repeats itself, and "impacchettare più strettamente" is a word-for-word rendering of "more tightly package". In [21], "insieme ... insieme" is also repetitive. In [5] and [9], "richiesta primitiva" and "job primitivo" read as a "primitive (basic) request/job" instead of a request or job sent to a primitive. [15] also switches between "tu hai accesso esclusivo" and "consente agli utenti" in the same paragraph.

examples.source: to more tightly package quantum execution across jobs, and then runs the quantum execution of each job in quick succession
examples.translation: per impacchettare più strettamente l'esecuzione quantistica tra i job, quindi esegue l'esecuzione quantistica di ciascun job in rapida successione
examples.suggested: per compattare l'esecuzione quantistica dei vari job, quindi esegue la parte quantistica di ciascun job in rapida successione
examples.why: Calque, and "esegue l'esecuzione" repeats itself.

examples.source: A single primitive request made without a context manager.
examples.translation: Una singola richiesta primitiva effettuata senza un context manager.
examples.suggested: Una singola richiesta a una primitiva, effettuata senza un context manager.
examples.why: "Richiesta primitiva" suggests a basic or primitive request, not a request sent to a Qiskit primitive.

examples.source: For batches, the entire batch of jobs is scheduled together.
examples.translation: Per i batch, l'intero insieme di job viene pianificato insieme.
examples.suggested: Nel caso dei batch, tutti i job del batch vengono pianificati insieme.
examples.why: "insieme ... insieme" is a clumsy repetition.

examples.source: the user has exclusive access of the system ... This allows users to experiment
examples.translation: tu hai accesso esclusivo al sistema ... Ciò consente agli utenti di sperimentare
examples.suggested: hai accesso esclusivo al sistema ... Ciò ti consente di sperimentare
examples.why: The paragraph mixes "tu" with "gli utenti" for the same person, and the explicit "tu" is unnatural.

editor_note: I found no semantic drift. The numbers, conditions and caveats all survive: 11 PUBs of 1000 circuits, 26.8 million instructions per qubit applied per job, estimator_options replacing the defaults wholesale, and batches queueing once. The gender of QPU changes within the file: it is masculine in [0], [42] and [53] ("un QPU", "al QPU", "sul QPU") and feminine in [59], [60] and [66] ("della QPU", "sulla QPU"). Link and anchor text is also inconsistent. The tutorial title is translated in [8] but left in English in [74], and [68] keeps "Authentication" although the heading is "Autenticazione". A few calques read stiffly: "ricade sul valore predefinito" and "a cui puoi scegliere di aderire" in [38], "contro un QPU reale" in [42], "la principale essendo" in [60], and "più intrecciati" for more-entangled in [49].

examples.source: the QPU's classical control system
examples.translation: del sistema di controllo classico della QPU
examples.suggested: del sistema di controllo classico del QPU (match the masculine used in [0], [42], [53])
examples.why: QPU is masculine in the first half of the file and feminine from here on.

examples.source: falls back to the default shown ... the rest of the table is the functionality you can opt into
examples.translation: ricade sul valore predefinito mostrato ... la funzionalità a cui puoi scegliere di aderire
examples.suggested: assume il valore predefinito indicato ... le funzionalità che puoi attivare a scelta
examples.why: This is a calque of 'fall back' and 'opt into'. A native technical writer would not phrase it this way.

examples.source: the main one being 26.8 million control-system instructions per qubit
examples.translation: la principale essendo 26,8 milioni di istruzioni del sistema di controllo per qubit
examples.suggested: la principale è di 26,8 milioni di istruzioni del sistema di controllo per qubit
examples.why: The absolute gerund construction copies the English syntax. The link text 'Job limits' is also left untranslated.

examples.source: later, more-entangled steps need a deeper one
examples.translation: i passi successivi, più intrecciati, richiedono un ansatz più profondo
examples.suggested: i passi successivi, con più entanglement, richiedono un ansatz più profondo
examples.why: The same sentence uses 'entanglement' just before this. 'Intrecciati' is not the conventional term for entangled.

examples.source: Work through [Simulate neutron scattering with an AQC + Trotter dynamics Serverless workflow]
examples.translation: Approfondisci con [Simulate neutron scattering with an AQC + Trotter dynamics Serverless workflow]
examples.suggested: Segui il tutorial [Simulare lo scattering di neutroni con un flusso di lavoro Serverless AQC + Trotter]
examples.why: The same tutorial title is translated in [8], so leaving it in English here is inconsistent.

editor_note: The body reads well and uses correct terms throughout (osservabili, stringhe di Pauli, matrice densa, aggiunto), with a consistent informal "tu" (Puoi, Consulta). The problem is the page heading [1]: it says "Panoramica del modulo Operators", which points to an "Operators" module that doesn't exist. The English means the operator classes, which live in quantum_info. Also, in [19] "l'inverso della forma" could be read as a matrix inverse rather than reversed order, and in [21] "ricavate come M-qubit e N-qubit" is a stiff calque of "assumed to be".

examples.source: Overview of operator classes
examples.translation: Panoramica del modulo Operators
examples.suggested: Panoramica delle classi di operatori
examples.why: The heading names an 'Operators' module that doesn't exist. The source is about operator classes in the quantum_info module.

examples.source: which is the reverse of the shape of the underlying matrix
examples.translation: che è l'inverso della forma della matrice sottostante
examples.suggested: che è in ordine inverso rispetto alla forma (shape) della matrice sottostante
examples.why: 'Inverso' next to 'matrice' can be read as a matrix inverse. The English means the tuple order is reversed.

examples.source: the input and output dimensions are automatically assumed to be M-qubit and N-qubit
examples.translation: le dimensioni di input e output vengono automaticamente ricavate come M-qubit e N-qubit
examples.suggested: le dimensioni di input e output vengono automaticamente considerate rispettivamente di M e N qubit
examples.why: This is a calque of the English. 'Rispettivamente' makes the M/N mapping explicit, which is more natural.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner. Core terms are correct and used consistently: "primitive", "valore di aspettazione", "mitigazione degli errori", "vettore di stato". A few spots need polish. In [7], "not a big issue" loses "big" and becomes "non era un problema", and "would not and should not" becomes "non dovrebbe né potrebbe familiarizzarsi", which changes "would" into "could". In [35], the text slips from "i propri utenti" to "i tuoi utenti" within one paragraph. In [16], "avvicina … di un passo a dove si trova oggi … dove il focus è" copies the English sentence structure, and the file writes "Sampler e Estimator" throughout where Italian requires "ed Estimator".

examples.source: This was not a big issue ... most developers would not and should not be familiar with distilling such raw data
examples.translation: Questo non era un problema ... non dovrebbe né potrebbe familiarizzarsi con la decodifica
examples.suggested: Questo non era un grosso problema ... la maggior parte degli sviluppatori non avrebbe avuto né dovuto avere familiarità con la conversione di tali dati grezzi
examples.why: This drops the intensifier "big" and turns "would not" into "could not". It is a small shift in nuance, not a misleading one.

examples.source: you can provide your users ... easier for your users to benefit from your hardware's
examples.translation: poter offrire ai propri utenti ... più facile per i tuoi utenti beneficiare delle migliori capacità del tuo hardware
examples.suggested: puoi offrire ai tuoi utenti un modo più "pronto all'uso" per accedere alle funzionalità del tuo hardware
examples.why: The paragraph switches between the impersonal "propri" and the direct "tuoi".

examples.source: moves quantum programming one step closer to where classical programming is today, where the focus is less on the hardware details
examples.translation: avvicina la programmazione quantistica di un passo a dove si trova oggi la programmazione classica, dove il focus è meno sui dettagli hardware
examples.suggested: avvicina di un passo la programmazione quantistica a quella classica di oggi, in cui l'attenzione si concentra meno sui dettagli hardware e più sui risultati
examples.why: The sentence follows English syntax. "a dove si trova" reads stiffly, and "il focus è" is an anglicism.

examples.source: their own Sampler and Estimator implementations
examples.translation: le proprie implementazioni di Sampler e Estimator
examples.suggested: le proprie implementazioni di Sampler ed Estimator
examples.why: Italian uses the euphonic "ed" before a vowel. The same slip appears in [29] and [37].

editor_note: Entry 14 keeps the English meaning. The isolated space, installing packages, libraries and dependencies, and leaving the "base" environment untouched all come through, and the tu register holds ("Usa", "puoi installare"). The only slip is that the definite article is missing twice, in "maggiori informazioni su **ambienti virtuali**" and "Usa [ambienti virtuali Python]". Both read like a calque of the English; a native editor would write "sugli ambienti virtuali" and "Usa gli ambienti virtuali Python".

examples.source: Click to expand for more information on **virtual environments**. - Use [Python virtual environments](...) to separate Qiskit from other applications.
examples.translation: Clicca per espandere e ottenere maggiori informazioni su **ambienti virtuali**. - Usa [ambienti virtuali Python](...) per separare Qiskit da altre applicazioni.
examples.suggested: Clicca per espandere e ottenere maggiori informazioni sugli **ambienti virtuali**. - Usa gli [ambienti virtuali Python](...) per separare Qiskit dalle altre applicazioni.
examples.why: Italian needs the definite article here (sugli / gli). Without it the phrasing follows the English and reads stiffly. The meaning is unaffected.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The shots precedence list [18]-[23] and the twirling caveat in [24] ("inferiore al valore di shots") come through correctly, so nothing here would mislead a learner. Four things a native editor would still fix. In [76], "directed" became "interazioni dirette", which in Italian reads as "direct" rather than "directed", and the right word is "orientate". The English loanword "shots" is kept in the plural ("gli shots", "valore di shots"), which clashes with the singular "per ogni shot" in [58]. In [102], the Qiskit "stretch" instruction is turned into "Stretching". A few phrases are calques, such as "per qualsiasi PUB particolare".

examples.source: List of directed two-qubit interactions
examples.translation: Elenco di interazioni dirette tra due qubit
examples.suggested: Elenco di interazioni orientate tra due qubit
examples.why: 'dirette' means direct/immediate, while 'directed' (graph edges with a direction) is 'orientate'. The coupling-map direction nuance is lost.

examples.source: These shot values are a part of the Sampler execution interface
examples.translation: Questi valori di shots fanno parte dell'interfaccia di esecuzione del Sampler
examples.suggested: Questi valori di shot fanno parte dell'interfaccia di esecuzione del Sampler
examples.why: Italian leaves English loanwords invariable ('gli shot'). The file also mixes 'shots' with 'per ogni shot' in [58].

examples.source: - Stretches
examples.translation: - Stretching
examples.suggested: - Stretch (istruzione `stretch`)
examples.why: 'Stretches' names Qiskit's stretch duration instruction. 'Stretching' suggests a generic process.

examples.source: for specifying shots in the Sampler, for any particular PUB
examples.translation: per specificare gli shots nel Sampler, per qualsiasi PUB particolare
examples.suggested: per specificare gli shot nel Sampler, per ciascun PUB
examples.why: 'qualsiasi PUB particolare' is a calque of the English. 'per ciascun PUB' is the natural wording.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and uses the informal register throughout, for example "È di fondamentale importanza mantenere i tuoi sistemi il più sicuri possibile" and "Consulta le politiche di sicurezza"; security policies becomes "politiche di sicurezza" consistently, and the repository link labels are correctly left in English.

The rewritten heading in entry 5, "Disaccoppiamento dinamico", is an accurate and standard Italian term and does not mislead. It does not match the body, though: entries 6 and 7 directly below it keep the English "dynamical decoupling" ("applicare il dynamical decoupling", "sequenza di dynamical decoupling XX"). So the section title and its text use two different names for the same technique. Either keep the English term in the heading or put the English in parentheses after the Italian, so a learner can see they are the same thing.

examples.source: Dynamical decoupling {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.translation: Disaccoppiamento dinamico {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.suggested: Disaccoppiamento dinamico (dynamical decoupling) {#dynamical-decoupling}
examples.why: The heading translates the term, but entries 6-7 keep the English "dynamical decoupling". Adding the English in parentheses links the heading to the text below it.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, and it keeps the informal "tu" ("ti guida", "puoi aprire", "Scarica"). Two small shifts in the hedged outlook paragraphs are worth fixing. In [6], "could have potential" becomes "potrebbe avere un grande potenziale": the added "grande" makes a deliberately cautious claim stronger, and "Indeed" is dropped. In [5], "that could feasibly be run any time soon" becomes "in tempi ragionevoli", which shifts the idea from "problems we could run in the near future" to "problems that run in a reasonable time". Neither changes the lesson's overall message, but both should be brought back in line with the English.

examples.source: As quantum computing technology advances, however, Grover's algorithm could have potential.
examples.translation: Con l'avanzare della tecnologia del calcolo quantistico, tuttavia, l'algoritmo di Grover potrebbe avere un grande potenziale.
examples.suggested: Con l'avanzare della tecnologia del calcolo quantistico, tuttavia, l'algoritmo di Grover potrebbe rivelarsi promettente.
examples.why: The added 'grande' strengthens a claim the source deliberately hedges, right after a paragraph of caveats.

examples.source: for any unstructured search problem that could feasibly be run any time soon.
examples.translation: per qualsiasi problema di ricerca non strutturata che potrebbe essere eseguito in tempi ragionevoli.
examples.suggested: per qualsiasi problema di ricerca non strutturata che si possa realisticamente eseguire nel prossimo futuro.
examples.why: 'In tempi ragionevoli' reads as 'within a reasonable running time', which loses the source's meaning of 'feasible in the near future'.

examples.source: Indeed, some of the most important and impactful classical algorithms ever discovered...
examples.translation: Alcuni degli algoritmi classici più importanti e influenti mai scoperti...
examples.suggested: In effetti, alcuni degli algoritmi classici più importanti e influenti mai scoperti...
examples.why: Dropping 'Indeed' weakens the link between the claim and the FFT/sorting analogy that supports it.

editor_note: The translation is accurate and consistently uses informal "tu" ("Benvenuto", "imparerai", "sostieni"). Nothing in it would mislead a learner. There are two small slips. In [11], the list of building blocks gives "ansatz circuits" in the singular ("circuito ansatz") while the other items are plural. In [0] the page says "a VQE" with no article, but [4] and [13] say "del VQE"/"al VQE". It also uses three different words for "building blocks": "blocchi costitutivi" in [0], "mattoni fondamentali" in [4] and "elementi fondamentali" in [11].

examples.source: (ansatz circuits, classical optimizers, and the Qiskit patterns framework)
examples.translation: (circuito ansatz, ottimizzatori classici e il framework dei pattern Qiskit)
examples.suggested: (circuiti ansatz, ottimizzatori classici e il framework dei pattern Qiskit)
examples.why: The English is plural. The singular sits oddly next to the plural "ottimizzatori" and suggests there is only one ansatz circuit.

examples.source: An introduction to VQE covering basic building blocks and applications.
examples.translation: Un'introduzione a VQE che copre i blocchi costitutivi di base e le applicazioni.
examples.suggested: Un'introduzione al VQE che ne illustra i mattoni fondamentali e le applicazioni.
examples.why: [4] and [13] use the article ("del VQE", "al VQE"), so this entry should too. "che copre" is also a calque of "covering", and "building blocks" is worded differently here than in [4] and [11].

editor_note: The translation is faithful throughout and uses the informal "tu" consistently ("Ti consigliamo", "Configura", "riceverai"). It renders "diagonalizzazione quantistica", "calcolo quantistico" and "scalabilità" correctly, and it does not mislead the learner. One wording slip remains in [4]: "Some background is provided" became "Vengono forniti alcuni riferimenti", which suggests a list of references rather than introductory background. A native editor would write "alcune nozioni di base" instead.

examples.source: Some background is provided on the classical methods that are used, or that motivated the quantum algorithms.
examples.translation: Vengono forniti alcuni riferimenti sui metodi classici utilizzati o che hanno ispirato gli algoritmi quantistici.
examples.suggested: Vengono fornite alcune nozioni di base sui metodi classici utilizzati o che hanno ispirato gli algoritmi quantistici.
examples.why: "Riferimenti" means references or citations. It does not mean the introductory background the course actually explains, so the nuance shifts slightly.

editor_note: The translation is faithful, and nothing in it would mislead a learner. The key claims survive intact: the upper-bound energy, amplitudes set to 0 for non-target vectors, and the argument against uniform sampling. A few things are still worth fixing. "Hamiltonian" is "l'Hamiltoniano" everywhere except [29], where it becomes "hamiltoniana". "Configuration recovery" is "recupero della configurazione" in [47] but stays in English in the table in [70]. There are also some calques: "infeasibile" in [64] is not a standard Italian word, and "termini di Pauli unici" / "circuiti unici" should use "distinti". The table row header "Estimated energy bound" loses "bound" and becomes just "Stima dell'energia". Entry [68] adds "tutti", which is not in the English, and [58] says "insieme di vettori mancanti", which reads as a set made of the missing vectors.

examples.source: writing the projected Hamiltonian elements
examples.translation: scrivendo gli elementi dell'hamiltoniana proiettata
examples.suggested: scrivendo gli elementi dell'Hamiltoniano proiettato
examples.why: Everywhere else in the file the term is the masculine, capitalized 'Hamiltoniano', so this one entry is inconsistent.

examples.source: which may become infeasible to diagonalize
examples.translation: che potrebbe diventare infeasibile da diagonalizzare
examples.suggested: che potrebbe diventare impraticabile (o proibitivo) da diagonalizzare
examples.why: 'Infeasibile' is a calque of the English word and not standard Italian.

examples.source: $2951$ unique Pauli terms ... $1187$ unique circuits; Estimated energy bound
examples.translation: $2951$ termini di Pauli unici ... $1187$ circuiti unici; Stima dell'energia
examples.suggested: $2951$ termini di Pauli distinti ... $1187$ circuiti distinti; Limite sull'energia stimata
examples.why: 'Unici' calques 'unique' (the meaning is 'distinct'). The row header also drops 'bound', which is the point that row contrasts.

examples.source: and we do not include basis states in the subspace
examples.translation: e non includiamo tutti gli stati di base nel sottospazio
examples.suggested: e non includiamo nel sottospazio stati di base rilevanti
examples.why: 'Tutti' is added and slightly shifts the claim: the problem is leaving out basis states that carry weight, not failing to include every basis state. It is minor because the example still fits either reading.

examples.source: if we span the subspace with such a set with missing vectors
examples.translation: se definiamo il sottospazio con un insieme di vettori mancanti
examples.suggested: se definiamo il sottospazio con un insieme simile, privo di alcuni vettori
examples.why: As written it reads as 'a set made of missing vectors' rather than 'a set that is missing vectors'.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner, but the page reads like two separate translations joined together. Up to about [123] it uses Italian terms ("caratteristica", "codifica in ampiezza/ad angolo/di fase", "layer"). From [124] on it switches to English ("feature", "amplitude/angle/phase/dense encoding", "strato"), and the summary list in [191] keeps the English names too. Grammatical gender also changes: "feature map/feature mapping" is masculine in [5] and [6] but feminine from [146] on, and [80] has "un singolo feature". There are also small slips: the accordion title is still "Answer" in [54] although [34] uses "Risposta", and the SWAP sentence in [202] shifts slightly, so the purpose "per consentire l'accoppiamento" becomes a relative clause about qubits "che consentono l'accoppiamento".

examples.source: Angle encoding, phase encoding, and dense encoding prepared product states with a feature encoded on each qubit
examples.translation: L'angle encoding, il phase encoding e il dense encoding preparano stati prodotto con una feature codificata su ogni qubit
examples.suggested: La codifica ad angolo, la codifica di fase e la codifica densa preparano stati prodotto con una caratteristica codificata su ogni qubit
examples.why: Up to [123] the file uses Italian names for the encodings and 'caratteristica' for feature. Here it suddenly switches to English terms and keeps them for the rest of the page.

examples.source: SWAP gates are added to move qubit states between qubits to enable coupling
examples.translation: vengono aggiunti gate SWAP per spostare gli stati dei qubit tra qubit che consentono l'accoppiamento
examples.suggested: vengono aggiunti gate SWAP per spostare gli stati dei qubit da un qubit all'altro, così da consentire l'accoppiamento
examples.why: In the English, enabling coupling is the purpose of the swaps. The translation turns it into a relative clause describing the qubits, which changes the sense slightly.

examples.source: <AccordionItem title="Answer">
examples.translation: <AccordionItem title="Answer">
examples.suggested: <AccordionItem title="Risposta">
examples.why: The title was left in English here, while [34] translates it as 'Risposta'.

examples.source: That was just a single feature of a single data vector.
examples.translation: Quello era solo un singolo feature di un singolo vettore dati.
examples.suggested: Quella era solo una singola caratteristica di un singolo vettore dati.
examples.why: This sentence uses English 'feature', while its own section says 'caratteristica' (it switches back in the next sentence). It also makes the word masculine, although 'feature' is feminine everywhere else.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The course overview (entry 4) keeps "kernel quantistici" and "circuiti quantistici variazionali" correct, and uses the informal "tu" consistently. Two phrasings in the badge and notice text read like translated English. In entry 6, "riceverai una notifica da Credly che hai guadagnato un badge" copies the English sentence structure and needs a linking phrase such as "che ti informa". In entry 11, "per la reportistica del programma e scopi operativi" leaves out the article and the preposition before "scopi".

examples.source: you will be notified by Credly that you have earned a badge
examples.translation: riceverai una notifica da Credly che hai guadagnato un badge
examples.suggested: riceverai una notifica da Credly che ti informa che hai ottenuto il badge
examples.why: Copies the English 'notified that' structure. In Italian 'notifica ... che hai guadagnato' reads as ungrammatical without a verb linking the two parts.

examples.source: for program reporting and operational purposes
examples.translation: per la reportistica del programma e scopi operativi
examples.suggested: per la reportistica del programma e per scopi operativi
examples.why: The coordination is missing its article and preposition, so the phrase reads clipped. A native editor would repeat 'per'.

editor_note: The translation is faithful and reads naturally, with the suppression, mitigation and correction distinction kept exactly. Terms are consistent throughout ("soppressione/mitigazione/rilevamento/correzione degli errori", "fault-tolerant", "shot", "Pauli twirling" glossed as "adattamento del rumore (noise tailoring)"), and the caveats in [7]–[8] are preserved.

Faithful and natural throughout, with a consistent informal "tu" register ("inizierai subito a usare un computer quantistico", "Se riesci a seguire un notebook e cliccare \"Run\"") and an accurate rendering of the Credly privacy notice ("elaboratore di dati terzo", "sussidiarie IBM").

I found no misleading drift. The CNOT truth table, Little Endian note, depth-4 explanation, 75% probability example and entanglement proof all match the English. What remains is polish. Several terms appear in more than one form: 'measurement' is both 'misura' and 'misurazione' (the 3.3 heading says 'Misurazione'), 'utility-scale' is both 'su scala utility' [12] and 'a scala di utilità' [183], 'statevector' is both 'simulatore di statevector'/'simulatore statevector' and 'vettore di stato' [127], and 'computazione quantistica' alternates with 'calcolo quantistico'. There are also a few calques: 'shallowest circuit' is 'circuito più superficiale' where 'meno profondo' is standard, 'sovrapposizione uguale' should be 'equiprobabile', and 'should show you' in [135] loses its hedge.

examples.source: Write code to prepare this state with the shallowest possible circuit. The depth of the shallowest quantum circuit is 5
examples.translation: con il circuito più superficiale possibile. La profondità del circuito quantistico più superficiale è 5
examples.suggested: con il circuito meno profondo possibile. La profondità minima del circuito quantistico è 5
examples.why: 'superficiale' is a calque that reads as 'superficial'. For circuit depth, Italian uses 'meno profondo' or 'di profondità minima'.

examples.source: obtaining a utility scale solution
examples.translation: ottenere una soluzione a scala di utilità
examples.suggested: ottenere una soluzione su scala utility
examples.why: Entry [12] renders the same concept as 'su scala utility'. 'scala di utilità' is a literal calque, and the file uses both.

examples.source: 3.3 Measurement
examples.translation: 3.3 Misurazione
examples.suggested: 3.3 Misura
examples.why: The intro list [11] and the summary [182] use 'misura', while section 3.3 uses 'misurazione'. The file mixes the two renderings.

examples.source: The results should show you that $|11\rangle$ has been measured with 100% probability.
examples.translation: I risultati mostrano che $|11\rangle$ è stato misurato con probabilità del 100%.
examples.suggested: I risultati dovrebbero mostrarti che $|11\rangle$ è stato misurato con probabilità del 100%.
examples.why: Dropping 'should' turns an expected result into a flat statement. This is a small loss of hedging and does not mislead.

examples.source: results in an equal superposition of $|0\rangle$ and $|1\rangle$
examples.translation: si ottiene una sovrapposizione uguale di $|0\rangle$ e $|1\rangle$
examples.suggested: si ottiene una sovrapposizione equiprobabile di $|0\rangle$ e $|1\rangle$
examples.why: 'sovrapposizione uguale' is a calque. The file already uses 'equiprobabile' [97] and 'uniforme' [113] elsewhere.

editor_note: Nothing here would mislead a learner, but the capitalization of the course titles is inconsistent. Most titles copy English Title Case ("Progettare e Guidare Progetti Quantistici", "Calcolo Quantistico in Pratica"), while [14] "Strumenti per il vantaggio quantistico" and [15] "Usa un computer quantistico oggi" use sentence case, which is the normal Italian convention. Two renderings also read as calques. "Calcolo Quantistico su Scala Utility" in [16] leaves "utility" as a bare English noun inside Italian syntax. "Fondamenti di Business Quantistico" in [9] makes the business itself "quantum", which the English title does not say.

examples.source: Utility Scale Quantum Computing
examples.translation: Calcolo Quantistico su Scala Utility
examples.suggested: Calcolo quantistico su scala utility (o: Calcolo quantistico a scala di utilità)
examples.why: This uses English Title Case, and 'su Scala Utility' is a stiff calque that leaves the English noun uninflected inside Italian syntax.

examples.source: Quantum Business Foundations
examples.translation: Fondamenti di Business Quantistico
examples.suggested: Fondamenti di quantum computing per il business
examples.why: 'Business quantistico' reads as if the business itself were quantum. The course is about the fundamentals of quantum technology for business.

examples.source: Designing And Leading Quantum Projects
examples.translation: Progettare e Guidare Progetti Quantistici
examples.suggested: Progettare e guidare progetti quantistici
examples.why: English Title Case is a calque in Italian. It is also inconsistent with the sentence-case titles in [14] and [15] on the same page.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout: the two-qubit worked example, the geometric picture, the iteration formula, the 20-qubit caveat and the Minesweeper caveats all match the source, and I found nothing that would mislead a learner. Six editorial slips remain. In [164], English "uncompute" becomes the untranslated non-word "dobbiamo **decompute**". [112] has a gender error: "quella dei non-soluzioni" should be "delle non-soluzioni". "Marked" is rendered two ways, "contrassegnato" in [15]/[42]/[77]–[83] and "marcato" in [9]/[111]–[188]. The repeated Qiskit-pattern step headings switch between imperative ("Mappa", "Ottimizza") and infinitive ("Mappare", "Ottimizzare", "Eseguire"). Minesweeper "board" becomes "scheda" in [145]/[152]/[174], which is unidiomatic next to "griglia". The article is wrong in "Il Hadamard gate" ([26]/[27]/[30]; it should be "L'Hadamard"/"il gate di Hadamard").

examples.source: we must **uncompute** — undo all the clause-evaluation steps
examples.translation: dobbiamo **decompute** — annullare tutti i passi di valutazione delle clausole
examples.suggested: dobbiamo eseguire l'**uncomputation** (de-calcolare) — annullare tutti i passi...
examples.why: 'decompute' is neither Italian nor the source term; the reader gets a garbled English non-word for a key concept.

examples.source: 10 times that of non-solutions
examples.translation: 10 volte quella dei non-soluzioni
examples.suggested: 10 volte quella delle non-soluzioni
examples.why: 'non-soluzioni' is feminine plural, so the article should be 'delle'. It is a visible grammar slip.

examples.source: one or more marked states
examples.translation: uno o più stati marcati
examples.suggested: uno o più stati contrassegnati
examples.why: Earlier sections ([42], [77], [83]) render 'marked' as 'contrassegnato'. The second half switches to 'marcato', so the term is inconsistent within the file.

examples.source: Step 1: Map classical inputs to a quantum problem
examples.translation: Passo 1: Mappare gli input classici in un problema quantistico
examples.suggested: Passo 1: Mappa gli input classici in un problema quantistico
examples.why: The same repeated heading appears as imperative 'Mappa' in [70]/[76]/[159] but as infinitive here. Step 3 is always 'Eseguire' while Step 2 is 'Ottimizza'. The heading style is mixed.

examples.source: how one would approach a larger board
examples.translation: come si potrebbe affrontare una scheda più grande
examples.suggested: come si potrebbe affrontare una griglia (un campo) più grande
examples.why: 'Scheda' means card/tab. A Minesweeper board is a 'griglia' or 'campo', and the file already uses 'griglia' elsewhere.

examples.source: Hadamard gates $H$ are well-known
examples.translation: Il Hadamard gate $H$ è ben noto
examples.suggested: Il gate di Hadamard $H$ è ben noto
examples.why: 'Il Hadamard' has the wrong article before a word read with a silent h. The file also alternates between 'Hadamard gate' and 'gate Hadamard'.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful overall, but a native editor would change a few renderings. In [5], "free time allotted" became "tempo libero assegnato", which reads as leisure or unused time rather than free-of-charge QPU time; it should be "tempo gratuito". "Teleportation" is rendered "teletrasportazione" in [0] and [4], but the conventional Italian term is "teletrasporto (quantistico)". Two smaller points: "answer keys" is calqued as "chiavi di risposta" in [6] when "soluzioni" is the natural term, and "instructor" appears as both "istruttore" in [5] and "docenti" in [4] and [6].

examples.source: in much less time than the free time allotted as part of the Open Plan
examples.translation: in molto meno tempo rispetto al tempo libero assegnato nell'ambito del piano Open
examples.suggested: in molto meno tempo rispetto al tempo gratuito assegnato con il piano Open
examples.why: 'tempo libero' means leisure or unoccupied time in Italian. The source means free-of-charge compute time.

examples.source: quantum teleportation
examples.translation: teletrasportazione quantistica
examples.suggested: teletrasporto quantistico
examples.why: The established Italian term is 'teletrasporto quantistico'. The same issue appears in [0].

examples.source: versions of these notebooks with answer keys
examples.translation: versioni di questi notebook con chiavi di risposta
examples.suggested: versioni di questi notebook con le soluzioni
examples.why: 'Chiavi di risposta' is a literal calque of 'answer keys'. Italian teaching material says 'soluzioni'.

examples.source: with group and instructor support
examples.translation: con il supporto del gruppo e dell'istruttore
examples.suggested: con il supporto del gruppo e del docente
examples.why: Entries [4] and [6] use 'docenti' for the same role, and 'docente' fits a university setting better.

editor_note: Both rewritten entries are faithful and natural: [76] keeps the "odd" condition ("con picchi su ogni numero binario dispari", which matches the answer in [77]), and [83] "Verifica la tua comprensione" matches the earlier heading [71].

Both rewritten entries keep the English meaning and would not mislead a learner. Entry 9's video title ("spiega la distribuzione quantistica delle chiavi e come può rendere possibile una comunicazione più sicura") is faithful and natural. Entry 121 gets every number and condition right (about 10 useful bits, 9 or 11 common, 4 or 15 possible, 5 bits per letter, at least 10 bits for 2 letters), but some phrasing is calqued from English: "una probabilità del 50-50 ... per qualsiasi qubit dato" and "9 o 11 sono perfettamente comuni". A native Italian technical editor would smooth these.

examples.source: Since there is roughly a 50-50 chance of the bases matching for any given qubit
examples.translation: Poiché c'è circa una probabilità del 50-50 che le basi coincidano per qualsiasi qubit dato
examples.suggested: Poiché per ciascun qubit la probabilità che le basi coincidano è circa del 50%
examples.why: In Italian, 'probabilità del 50-50' and 'qualsiasi qubit dato' read as word-for-word copies of the English. The meaning is still correct.

examples.source: 9 or 11 will be perfectly common. Even 4 or 15 are not outside the realm of possibility.
examples.translation: 9 o 11 sono perfettamente comuni. Anche 4 o 15 non sono fuori dal campo delle possibilità.
examples.suggested: 9 o 11 sono del tutto normali. Anche 4 o 15 non sono impossibili.
examples.why: 'Perfettamente comuni' copies the English 'perfectly common'. 'Del tutto normali' is the natural Italian phrase, and 'non sono impossibili' is less stiff than 'fuori dal campo delle possibilità'.

editor_note: Entry 29, "Quindi arriveresti a destinazione alle 20:00, ossia le 8 di sera", matches the English: it keeps 20:00, glosses 8 PM correctly and fits the 8:00 + 60 h setup in entry 25.

None of the 15 rewritten entries changes the meaning. The Coulomb/Bohr-radius steps (185-194) and the negative reaction energy caveat in 204 are faithful. However, entries 0 and 69 now render VQE as "autorisolutore quantistico variazionale", a rare coinage that Italian practitioners don't normally use. It also clashes with the rest of the page, which keeps "Variational Quantum Eigensolver" / "variational quantum eigensolver" in English (entries 1, 4, 70, 197). Entry 102 translates one word-bank item as "energia dello stato fondamentale", but its sibling items (101, 103, 105, 107) and the answer key (110 "2 → ground state energy") stay in English, so the quiz no longer matches up.

examples.source: VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver)
examples.translation: VQE (Autorisolutore quantistico variazionale)
examples.suggested: VQE (Variational Quantum Eigensolver)
examples.why: 'Autorisolutore' is a rare coinage. The page elsewhere keeps the English name (entries 1, 4, 70, 197), so the expansion is inconsistent. Entry 0 has the same problem.

examples.source: ground state energy
examples.translation: energia dello stato fondamentale
examples.suggested: ground state energy (to match the other word-bank items and answer key 110), or translate the whole word bank and answer key together
examples.why: Only this word-bank item is translated. The other items and the answer key '2 → ground state energy' stay in English, so the word bank no longer lines up with the answers.

editor_note: All three entries are faithful and use the standard Italian terms: Modules→Moduli, Computer Science→Informatica, Quantum Mechanics→Meccanica Quantistica. Title case works here because it is a section title.

Entry 29 is faithful and reads naturally. "Sarebbe molto impressionante se riuscissi a ideare un esperimento… agli esseri umani ci sono voluti decenni per trovarne uno" keeps the informal "tu" and the "decades" claim, and uses "opzioni di Einstein e di Born" as entry 28 does.

The meaning is faithful overall, but entry [4] turns "the free time allotted as part of the Open Plan" into "tempo libero", which in Italian means leisure time. It should be "tempo gratuito", which the same paragraph already uses for "free quantum computing time". Entry [4] also renders the programme name "Qiskit in classrooms" as "per le aule scolastiche", which suggests schools rather than university courses. Entry [7] has the awkward construction "indicazioni su in quale parte", and entry [8] firms up "should be sufficient" to "sono sufficienti".

examples.source: in much less than the free time allotted as part of the Open Plan
examples.translation: in molto meno tempo rispetto al tempo libero disponibile nell'ambito del piano Open
examples.suggested: in molto meno tempo rispetto al tempo gratuito previsto dal piano Open
examples.why: 'Tempo libero' means leisure time, not free-of-charge compute time. It also clashes with 'tempo gratuito' later in the same paragraph.

examples.source: This collection of Qiskit in classrooms modules
examples.translation: Questa raccolta di moduli Qiskit per le aule scolastiche
examples.suggested: Questa raccolta di moduli di Qiskit in Classrooms
examples.why: 'Qiskit in classrooms' is a programme name. Translating it as 'aule scolastiche' suggests secondary school, but this is an undergraduate course.

examples.source: recommendations on where in a curriculum each module might be most effective
examples.translation: indicazioni su in quale parte del curriculum potrebbe risultare più efficace
examples.suggested: indicazioni sul punto del curriculum in cui potrebbe risultare più efficace
examples.why: 'su in quale parte' is a clumsy calque that a native editor would rephrase.

examples.source: 2x2 matrices should be sufficient
examples.translation: le matrici 2x2 sono sufficienti
examples.suggested: le matrici 2x2 dovrebbero bastare
examples.why: This drops the hedge 'should', which slightly strengthens the claim.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout and nothing would mislead a learner. The table descriptions translate correctly: "tagliando gate e fili", "stima dello stato fondamentale" and "overhead di campionamento PEC". Keeping the addon product names (Operator Back-Propagation, Shaded Lightcones) in English is a defensible choice. The one slip is the heading "Addon Disponibili", which copies English title case. Italian writes headings in sentence case, so it should be "Addon disponibili".

examples.source: Available Addons
examples.translation: Addon Disponibili
examples.suggested: Addon disponibili
examples.why: Italian headings use sentence case, so capitalizing the adjective copies English title case.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The mirror-circuit caveats [69], the single-circuit disclaimer [94] and the per-metric SABRE/AI split [87] all survive intact, and nothing would mislead a learner. A native editor would still fix some calques. [68] renders "shallower circuit" as "circuito più superficiale" instead of "meno profondo". [98] "Il transpiler AI vale la pena provare" is ungrammatical. [16] "mette a benchmark" and [87] "i due performer più forti" read as translationese. "Qiskit transpiler" keeps English word order where Italian would say "il transpiler di Qiskit", and [37] "gate base" should be "gate di base".

examples.source: A compilation method that produces a shallower circuit with fewer gates will accumulate less noise.
examples.translation: Un metodo di compilazione che produce un circuito più superficiale con meno gate accumula meno rumore.
examples.suggested: Un metodo di compilazione che produce un circuito meno profondo e con meno gate accumula meno rumore.
examples.why: 'superficiale' is a literal calque of 'shallow'. With circuits, Italian says 'meno profondo' (it matches 'profondità').

examples.source: **The AI-powered transpiler** is worth trying when compilation time is not a constraint
examples.translation: **Il transpiler AI** vale la pena provare quando il tempo di compilazione non è un vincolo
examples.suggested: Vale la pena provare **il transpiler AI** quando il tempo di compilazione non è un vincolo
examples.why: Putting the subject first mirrors the English syntax and makes the sentence ungrammatical in Italian.

examples.source: SABRE and the AI-powered transpiler are the two strongest performers
examples.translation: SABRE e il transpiler AI sono i due performer più forti
examples.suggested: SABRE e il transpiler AI sono i due metodi più efficaci
examples.why: 'performer più forti' is an unnecessary anglicism and a calque.

examples.source: This tutorial benchmarks three compilation methods
examples.translation: Questo tutorial mette a benchmark tre metodi di compilazione
examples.suggested: Questo tutorial confronta tramite benchmark tre metodi di compilazione
examples.why: 'mettere a benchmark' is not idiomatic Italian. Elsewhere the file says 'eseguiamo il benchmark'.

examples.source: The backend determines the coupling map and basis gates that the transpiler targets.
examples.translation: Il backend determina la mappa di connettività e i gate base che il transpiler utilizza come target.
examples.suggested: Il backend determina la mappa di connettività e i gate di base verso cui il transpiler compila.
examples.why: The usual term is 'gate di base'. 'utilizza come target' is also stiff.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the fault-tolerance and scaling caveats in [44], [47] and [50]. The core terms are used consistently: contrassegnare for "mark", gate, transpiliamo, primitiva Sampler, and "a tolleranza di errore" for "fault-tolerant". The remaining problems are small. In [33], the calqued semicolon clause "; creando ..." is followed by "seguita" agreeing with "sovrapposizione", so the text reads as if the superposition, not the Hadamard layer, is followed by the Grover operator. The stiff calques "al cuore di" ([44], [47]) and "senza soluzione di continuità" ([15]) remain, and in [52] "esempi a breve termine" is an awkward rendering of "near-term examples".

examples.source: starts with a Hadamard gate on each qubit; creating an even superposition of all computational basis states, followed the Grover operator
examples.translation: inizia con un gate Hadamard su ogni qubit; creando una sovrapposizione uniforme di tutti gli stati della base computazionale, seguita dall'operatore di Grover
examples.suggested: inizia con un gate Hadamard su ogni qubit, che crea una sovrapposizione uniforme di tutti gli stati della base computazionale, seguito dall'operatore di Grover
examples.why: The semicolon and gerund are calqued from the English. The feminine 'seguita' attaches to 'sovrapposizione' rather than to the Hadamard layer.

examples.source: the multi-controlled Z gates at the heart of the oracle and diffusion operator
examples.translation: i gate Z multi-controllati al cuore dell'oracolo e dell'operatore di diffusione
examples.suggested: i gate Z multi-controllati alla base dell'oracolo e dell'operatore di diffusione
examples.why: 'al cuore di' is a literal calque; an Italian technical writer would say 'alla base di' or 'al centro di'. The same phrase appears again in [47].

examples.source: The runtime `Sampler` primitive allows seamless execution of Grover circuits.
examples.translation: La primitiva `Sampler` del runtime consente l'esecuzione senza soluzione di continuità dei circuiti di Grover.
examples.suggested: La primitiva `Sampler` del runtime permette di eseguire i circuiti di Grover in modo semplice e diretto.
examples.why: 'senza soluzione di continuità' is a heavy, bureaucratic rendering of 'seamless' and does not fit a tutorial register.

examples.source: give near-term examples of optimization with quantum computers
examples.translation: forniscono esempi a breve termine di ottimizzazione con computer quantistici
examples.suggested: forniscono esempi di ottimizzazione con i computer quantistici attuali (near-term)
examples.why: 'esempi a breve termine' makes the examples themselves sound short-lived. 'Near-term' describes the current generation of hardware.

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout. The variational-bound, M_J-on-products and first-order vs. exact-angle arguments all hold, and I found no drift or hallucination. The problems are consistency ones. "Hamiltonian" switches from masculine "l'Hamiltoniano" in the first half ([0], [22], [33]) to feminine "la Hamiltoniana" later ([114], [133], [134], [151], [157]). "Shell" does the same, "la shell $sd$" vs "lo shell $pf$". Qubit excitations appear as "eccitazioni a qubit", "eccitazioni di qubit" and untranslated "qubit-excitation" ([72]). Section link labels are also inconsistent: "[Background]" ([104]) and "[Setup]" ([163]) sit alongside "Contesto"/"Impostazione" elsewhere. Smaller things: calques such as "nomina un determinante" and "seminato dalla teoria", the imperative "Post-elabora" when the other step headings use infinitives, and "e eseguirla" instead of "ed eseguirla".

examples.source: something is wrong with the Hamiltonian, not with the hardware
examples.translation: qualcosa non va nella Hamiltoniana, non nell'hardware
examples.suggested: qualcosa non va nell'Hamiltoniano, non nell'hardware
examples.why: The first half of the file uses masculine 'l'Hamiltoniano' ([0], [22], [33]); the later half switches to feminine 'la Hamiltoniana'. Pick one.

examples.source: Dropping the $Z$ strings gives the *qubit-excitation* operator of Yordanov et al.
examples.translation: Eliminare le stringhe $Z$ dà l'operatore di *qubit-excitation* di Yordanov et al.
examples.suggested: Eliminando le stringhe $Z$ si ottiene l'operatore di *eccitazione a qubit* di Yordanov et al.
examples.why: The term is left in English here, rendered 'eccitazioni a qubit' in [70]/[98] and 'eccitazioni di qubit' in [145]/[174]. Use one rendering.

examples.source: each measured bitstring names one Slater determinant
examples.translation: ogni stringa di bit misurata nomina un determinante di Slater
examples.suggested: ogni stringa di bit misurata identifica un determinante di Slater
examples.why: 'Nomina' is a calque of 'names'. A native technical writer would say 'identifica' or 'corrisponde a'.

examples.source: described in the [Background](#background) section
examples.translation: descritti nella sezione [Background](#background)
examples.suggested: descritti nella sezione [Contesto](#background)
examples.why: The heading is translated 'Contesto' ([20], [92]), so this link label doesn't match its target. [163] has the same problem, with '[Setup]' vs 'Impostazione'.

examples.source: The circuit is fixed, seeded from second-order perturbation theory, and never optimized.
examples.translation: Il circuito è fisso, seminato dalla teoria delle perturbazioni del secondo ordine, e mai ottimizzato.
examples.suggested: Il circuito è fisso, inizializzato a partire dalla teoria delle perturbazioni del secondo ordine, e mai ottimizzato.
examples.why: 'Seminato' is a literal rendering of 'seeded' and sounds odd in Italian technical prose.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The bias/overhead trade-off, the timeout caveat in [86], the note that plain PEC is unbiased in [149] and the ~3.4-fold reduction figures all match the English. The problems are local. In [62], "drift over time" becomes "derivano nel tempo", which is a wrong verb. The hardware "edge" is rendered as "bordo" in [20] and [146], which reads as the physical border of the device. There are two grammar slips: "I shaded lightcone" in [17] and "dei errori" in [21]. Terminology is also split. The page's key term appears as "coni di luce ombreggiati", "shaded lightcone" and "lightcone", and "primitive" appears both as "la primitiva Estimator" and "il primitivo Executor".

examples.source: coherence times and gate fidelities vary across a device and drift over time
examples.translation: variano attraverso un dispositivo e derivano nel tempo
examples.suggested: variano da un punto all'altro del dispositivo e subiscono una deriva nel tempo
examples.why: 'Derivare' means 'to originate from', not 'to drift'. The phrase is wrong and reads as nonsense.

examples.source: locally generated on each qubit and edge of the device
examples.translation: generati localmente su ogni qubit e bordo del dispositivo
examples.suggested: generati localmente su ogni qubit e su ogni collegamento (arco) del dispositivo
examples.why: Here 'edge' is a coupling-graph edge. 'Bordo' suggests the physical border of the chip. The same problem appears as 'bordi spettatori' in [146].

examples.source: Shaded lightcones (SLC) go further
examples.translation: I shaded lightcone (SLC) vanno oltre
examples.suggested: I coni di luce ombreggiati (SLC) vanno oltre
examples.why: The article is ungrammatical: it should be 'Gli' before 's+consonant'. The term also switches from 'coni di luce ombreggiati' in [0]-[7] to English 'shaded lightcone'/'lightcone' in later sections.

examples.source: Bound per-error impact of one- and two-qubit Pauli errors
examples.translation: Limita l'impatto per errore dei errori di Pauli a uno e due qubit
examples.suggested: Limita l'impatto di ciascun errore di Pauli a uno e due qubit
examples.why: 'dei errori' is a grammar error (it should be 'degli errori'), and 'impatto per errore' is a calque.

examples.source: Mirroring the circuit gets us most of the way there
examples.translation: Riflettere il circuito ci porta gran parte della strada
examples.suggested: Specchiare il circuito ci porta quasi al risultato
examples.why: This is a literal calque of an English idiom. It also conflicts with 'specchiatura' used in [58].

editor_note: Entry [117] renders "refs_to_noise_models does not have to be provided" as "non deve essere fornito". In Italian that means "must not be provided", so an optional argument reads as a forbidden one and the learner gets a false instruction. Entry [88] misreads the samplomatic term "left-dressed" (single-qubit gates dressed on the left side of the box) as "lasciati vestiti" ("left dressed"), which loses the technical meaning. Several terms also switch within the file: gate/porte ([122], [132], [149] vs. "gate" elsewhere), Fase/Passo for the pattern steps, layer/livello di rumore ([92] vs. [136]), and post-selection/post-selezione.

examples.source: In that case, `refs_to_noise_models` does not have to be provided.
examples.translation: In tal caso, `refs_to_noise_models` non deve essere fornito.
examples.suggested: In tal caso, non è necessario fornire `refs_to_noise_models`.
examples.why: "Non deve" means "must not" in Italian, which turns an optional argument into a prohibition.

examples.source: Single-qubit gates are left-dressed within the boxes.
examples.translation: I gate a singolo qubit vengono lasciati vestiti ("dressed") all'interno dei box.
examples.suggested: I gate a singolo qubit vengono assorbiti come dressing a sinistra ("left-dressed") all'interno dei box.
examples.why: "Left-dressed" means dressed on the left side. "Lasciati vestiti" reads it as "left in a dressed state", which misreads the term.

examples.source: mitigating the learned gate noise
examples.translation: mitigare il rumore delle porte appreso
examples.suggested: mitigare il rumore dei gate appreso
examples.why: The file uses "gate" everywhere else. Entries 122, 132 and 149 switch to "porte".

examples.source: We set each noise layer's scale to `0.0`
examples.translation: Impostiamo la scala di ogni livello di rumore a `0.0`
examples.suggested: Impostiamo la scala di ogni layer di rumore a `0.0`
examples.why: Entry 92 calls noise layers "layer di rumore". Here they become "livello", so readers may think it is a different concept.

examples.source: Step 3: Execute quantum experiments
examples.translation: Passo 3: Eseguire esperimenti quantistici
examples.suggested: Fase 3: Eseguire gli esperimenti quantistici
examples.why: Steps 1 and 2 of the pattern use "Fase". Steps 3 and 4 switch to "Passo".

editor_note: The meaning is faithful throughout, including the O(N^2) and N(N+1)/2 cost argument in [47] and [49], so nothing here would mislead a learner. The page description [0] uses the plural imperative "Costruite", which breaks the "tu" register used everywhere else ("assicurati", "consulta", "Utilizza"). "Up to shot noise" in [24] is calqued as "fino al rumore dei shot", which also has an article error. "Overlap circuit" becomes "circuito di sovrapposizione" in [45] and [47], and in a quantum text Italian readers first take "sovrapposizione" to mean superposition.

examples.source: Build a Qiskit pattern for evaluating entries...
examples.translation: Costruite un pattern Qiskit per valutare le voci...
examples.suggested: Costruisci un pattern Qiskit per valutare le voci...
examples.why: Plural 'voi' imperative, while the rest of the page uses informal 'tu'.

examples.source: A statevector simulator is exact (up to shot noise)
examples.translation: Un simulatore statevector è esatto (fino al rumore dei shot)
examples.suggested: Un simulatore statevector è esatto (a meno del rumore di shot)
examples.why: 'Up to' here means 'modulo', not 'fino a'. The literal calque reads oddly, and 'dei shot' should be 'degli shot'.

examples.source: on the overlap circuit ... this particular overlap circuit
examples.translation: sul circuito di sovrapposizione ... questo particolare circuito di sovrapposizione
examples.suggested: sul circuito di overlap ... questo particolare circuito di overlap
examples.why: In a quantum context 'sovrapposizione' normally means superposition, so it can blur the idea of a circuit that computes the overlap (fidelity) of two states.

editor_note: The meaning holds throughout. The caveats about scaling, the "not immediate quantum advantage" point in [67], the 82%/18% split in [61] and the auto-regularization disclaimer in [62] all match the source. The problems are anglicisms and inconsistent terms. "Step" is kept in the English everywhere (headings "Step 1:" and body text) but becomes "passo" in [64]; "workflow" turns into "flusso di lavoro" in [7]; "test set" in [43] becomes "set di test" in [71]; "loop ibrido" in [41] sits next to "ciclo" in [65]/[80]; and "quantum-enhanced" in [1]/[27] is rendered "ottimizzati quantisticamente" in [76]. There are also a few calques: "effettivamente" for "effectively" (the Italian word means "actually", not "in effect") in [48], "α-regolarizzazione" instead of "regolarizzazione α", and "illustrano ... per illustrare" in [45]. The register is consistent informal plural voi throughout, not Lei.

examples.source: effectively the number of weak learners combined
examples.translation: effettivamente il numero di weak learner combinati
examples.suggested: in pratica il numero di weak learner combinati
examples.why: False friend: 'effettivamente' means 'actually/indeed', not 'in effect/essentially'.

examples.source: This step compares predictive quality
examples.translation: Questo passo confronta la qualità predittiva
examples.suggested: Use one rendering throughout (e.g. 'passo'/'fase' everywhere, including the 'Step 1–4' headings)
examples.why: Everywhere else the file keeps the English 'step' ('Step 1', 'questo step'), so 'passo' here is inconsistent.

examples.source: adaptive α-regularization automatically tunes sparsity
examples.translation: la α-regolarizzazione adattiva regola automaticamente la sparsità
examples.suggested: la regolarizzazione α adattiva regola automaticamente la sparsità
examples.why: Prefixing the Greek letter copies the English word order; Italian puts the modifier after the noun.

examples.source: The next subsections walk through three representative configurations to illustrate these effects.
examples.translation: Le prossime sottosezioni illustrano tre configurazioni rappresentative per illustrare questi effetti.
examples.suggested: Le prossime sottosezioni presentano tre configurazioni rappresentative che mostrano questi effetti.
examples.why: Clumsy repetition of 'illustrare' in one sentence.

examples.source: The quantum-enhanced models replicate classical accuracy
examples.translation: I modelli ottimizzati quantisticamente replicano l'accuratezza classica
examples.suggested: I modelli quantum-enhanced replicano l'accuratezza classica
examples.why: 'quantum-enhanced' is kept in English in [1]/[27] but rendered 'ottimizzati quantisticamente' here. That phrase blurs it with 'quantum-optimized' ([6], [69]), a different term in the source.

editor_note: Entry 32 is faithful and natural: "Opt Mapper Qiskit addon" becomes "Componente aggiuntivo Qiskit Opt Mapper", which uses the standard Italian word for add-on, keeps the product name unchanged and leaves the pip command intact.

Nothing here would mislead a learner. The explanations of qubits, superposition, CNOT/Bell states and the Sampler/Estimator primitives match the English, and the text uses "tu" throughout. The main problem is a broken plural that looks like a term-substitution artifact: "i circuito" and "tutti i circuito" appear in entries 63, 103, 106 and 110 (should be "circuiti"), and entry 60 has "widget per i circuito" and "circuito Composer". Some text is still English or inconsistent. Entries 76, 118 and 123 are untranslated. "primitives" is rendered as the wrong-gender "primitivi" (9, 10) but as "primitive" in 105. "statevector" (94) and "vettore di stato" (50) are both used. The Qiskit-pattern steps mix English verbs with Italian objects ("**Map** il problema", "**Post-process** i risultati").

examples.source: copy and paste the code it provides into the respective cells to create the quantum circuits
examples.translation: copiare il codice che ti fornisce nelle rispettive celle per creare i circuito quantistici
examples.suggested: copiare il codice che ti fornisce nelle rispettive celle per creare i circuiti quantistici
examples.why: Ungrammatical plural ("i circuito"). The same broken form also appears in 103, 106 and 110, as well as "circuito Composer" in 60.

examples.source: 4. Quantum Quiz with Multi-Qubit Gates
examples.translation: 4. Quantum Quiz with Multi-Qubit gates
examples.suggested: 4. Quiz quantistico con gate multi-qubit
examples.why: The section heading was left in English. Entries 118 ("Created by") and 123 (the licence sentence) are also untranslated.

examples.source: extended quantum circuits. Operators and primitives.
examples.translation: a livello di Circuit quantistici estesi, operatori e primitivi
examples.suggested: circuiti quantistici estesi, operatori e primitive
examples.why: The Qiskit primitives are "le primitive" in Italian, which is the form entry 105 uses. "primitivi" (also in 10) is the wrong gender and makes the term inconsistent.

examples.source: **Map** problem to quantum circuits and operators
examples.translation: **Map** il problema in Circuit quantistici e operatori
examples.suggested: **Mappare** il problema in circuiti quantistici e operatori (Map)
examples.why: An English verb followed by an Italian object reads as a hybrid. Either translate the step verb or keep the English label as a separate tag. Entry 100 has the same problem.

editor_note: The three rewritten entries are faithful and read naturally: "Post-elaborazione" (109), the Apache License text with "directory principale di questo repository di codice sorgente" (122), and the obligation "devono mantenere questa nota di copyright… alterati rispetto agli originali" (123), which keeps the full legal meaning.

Five of the six rewritten headings are faithful. The "Passo 1–4" headings read naturally and match the earlier "(spiegate in dettaglio nel Passo 3)", and backend is kept lowercase in 100 and 102. Entry 120 has a problem: it renders "Amplitude encoding" as "Codifica dell'ampiezza", which reads as encoding the amplitude itself. The usual Italian term is "codifica in ampiezza", and the body text in entry 121 even keeps "amplitude encoding" in English, so the heading and the body do not match. A smaller point: "Post-elabora" in entry 104 does not match "post-processare" in entry 88, though "Post-elabora" is defensible.

examples.source: 3.1 Amplitude encoding
examples.translation: 3.1 Codifica dell'ampiezza
examples.suggested: 3.1 Codifica in ampiezza
examples.why: The method stores data in the amplitudes; it does not encode the amplitude itself. 'Codifica in ampiezza' is the usual Italian term, and 'dell'ampiezza' suggests the wrong direction. It also does not match entry 121, which keeps 'amplitude encoding' in English.

examples.source: Step 4. Post-process results
examples.translation: Passo 4. Post-elabora i risultati
examples.suggested: Passo 4. Post-elabora i risultati (and align entry 88's 'post-processare' to 'post-elaborare')
examples.why: Minor inconsistency: this entry uses 'post-elabora' but entry 88 uses 'post-processare' for the same concept.
